name: Schemzade
source:
Bezel’s queen, she is a demon proficient in magic.

She taught Bezel how to steal the Demon King’s power, and is the one who blocked off the path between Earth and the heavens, leaving Ixseal isolated from her peers.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1471&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
